verified_facts.text: Mount Lofty House was built in 1852 by statesman Arthur Hardy as his summer house.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mount Lofty House was built in 1852 by prominent statesman Arthur Hardy as his summer house.

verified_facts.text: The house was built on the summit of Mount Lofty.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hardy and his wife Martha built their summer house on the summit of Mount Lofty in 1852

verified_facts.text: The original house was burnt to the ground in the 1983 Ash Wednesday fires.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the disastrous 1983 fires of Ash Wednesday Mount Lofty House was burnt to the ground

verified_facts.text: It reopened as a luxury boutique hotel on 12 February 1986 after being completely rebuilt.
verified_facts.excerpt: marking the moment it reopened on 12th February 1986 after being completely rebuilt following the devastating Ash Wednesday Bushfires of 1983

verified_facts.text: The manor passed through several South Australian families and was a commune in the 1970s.

verified_facts.text: Mount Lofty House is a retreat for adults.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is 15 minutes from Adelaide CBD and 25 minutes from Adelaide airport.
